stem: A disease can be described as infectious or non-infectious.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Lung cancer is a non-infectious disease.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
In a person with lung cancer one or more healthy cells undergo changes to produce cancerous cells that can form a tumour.

Suggest **and** explain the cellular changes that occur in the development of lung cancer.
